name: stray-research
description: Repo-local Codex plugin for research, analysis, product direction, and terms checks.

interface.shortDescription: Research and analysis plugin for current, source-backed investigation and decision support.
interface.longDescription: A repo-local Codex plugin for source-backed research workflows. It offers concise web answers and domain investigations that scale from focused briefs, including code/model-license fact checks, to multi-track evidence synthesis with source-conflict handling; distills supplied pages safely; investigates existing software features and version differences from shipped artifacts and observed behavior using available tools, with optional REA and explicit evidence limits; expands ideas into distinct concept families with labeled creative hypotheses, compares them on request, and makes evidence-backed product decisions through a separate skill, including human/AI responsibilities and workflow, agent, or combined control selection; designs MCP servers, shared application contracts, safe writes, and read-only or mutation evaluation contracts without executing them; summarizes Japan news; retrieves JMA weather and identified-company gBizINFO data; triages GitHub maintenance read-only; conducts global or Japan-focused public patent research; checks practical API or SaaS terms; and analyzes Japanese horse racing with current-source, confidentiality, prompt-injection, legal-boundary, and responsible-use guardrails.
defaultPrompt: Research a current topic on the web and return a concise sourced brief.
Extract the useful content from a web page and turn it into clean markdown.
Investigate specialized or multi-track technical, licensing, regulatory, market, or academic questions, reconcile evidence and conflicts, and return the requested sourced brief or report.
Explain an existing software feature or version difference from supplied packages, binaries, firmware, or observed app/web behavior, with evidence and unresolved gaps.
Use current web signals to expand ideas into distinct concept families, mark creative leaps and unknowns, and leave ranking for an explicit comparison request.
Design a product direction or feature brief using supplied evidence and targeted current research where needed, including AI responsibilities and workflow, agent, or combined control when relevant.
Plan or review MCP server contracts, safe writes, and read-only or mutation evaluation before implementation.
Summarize the latest Japanese news in a fixed brief format using current web sources.
Retrieve Japan Meteorological Agency station, AMeDAS, recent historical, time-series, and forecast weather data with exact timestamps and caveats.
Search and summarize Japanese corporate information from gBizINFO with corporate numbers, endpoint provenance, and missing-data boundaries.
Triage GitHub maintenance work and recommend the next actions.
Plan or conduct a public-web global patent research workflow with cautious, source-backed findings.
Conduct a Japan-focused public patent search with J-PlatPat, Japanese terminology, FI, F-term, a reproducible search log, and no legal conclusions.
Check the current terms or usage restrictions for an API or SaaS before integrating or shipping it.
Analyze a Japanese horse racing race using official, licensed, or user-provided data, with probability ranges, value checks, risk notes, and no automated wagering.
